description: Searches the values of one field by text, such as towns matching leeds, and returns each code with its contact and company counts plus did_you_mean for near misses. Use the returned code in a filter rather than guessing one. Free and needs no account; results are paged with next_cursor. Call count_audience once the filters are chosen. Lawful basis is UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interests; email audiences include corporate subscribers only by default (PECR), so sole traders and ordinary partnerships are left out unless the toggle is changed.

cursor.description: An opaque cursor from next_cursor. Pass it back unchanged.

dataset.description: The dataset an audience draws from. uk_contacts is live; ie_contacts and global_contacts are listed but not yet served.

dimension.description: A field name from list_filters, such as site.town or company.sic_2007.

name: search_filter_values

CellCount.description: A whole number; "under 10" when disclosure control withholds a small cell; or "suppressed" when secondary suppression hides a cell of 10 or more in a cross-tab or breakdown, so totals cannot be differenced. Anonymous and trial callers see cells rounded to the nearest 5.

Disclosure.description: Whether these numbers are exact or protected: "under 10" cells, rounding to 5 and secondary suppression for anonymous and trial callers.

level.description: exact for authenticated paid callers; rounded for anonymous and trial callers, whose counts under 100 and every cell are rounded to the nearest 5.

rounded_to.description: 5 when numbers are rounded; null when they are exact.

secondary_suppression.description: True when cross-tab or breakdown cells of 10 or more were hidden as "suppressed" so totals cannot be differenced.

FilterValue.description: One value of a field, with its counts.

code.description: The value to use in a filter.

parent.description: The parent code for hierarchical fields, such as SIC division 62 under J.

outputSchema.description: A page of values in one field, best match first when q is given.

dataset_version.description: The immutable weekly build a count is bound to, such as 2026-W39. The last 52 stay queryable.

anyOf.description: An opaque cursor from next_cursor. Pass it back unchanged.

title: Search filter values
